answer: Joining costs a 400 POA bond locked 120 days, paid in full for each fake, because one bond never covers two agents. The bond sits in escrow and thaws only after the agent finishes ten real jobs, each recorded in a crystal ledger no one can rewrite. A nebula of rotating checkers assigns every job blind, so a farm cannot feed work to its own copies. A lantern audit lights up copied work; a caught fake loses the whole bond and its key is barred for three years.
